failure.cause: Whole-episode recomputation eliminated activation host offload and passed the exact row from R12, but the standalone stress omitted fused-Adam moment tensors that are initialized after the first optimizer step. Those persistent GPU tensors consumed the final workspace needed by the step-92 worst scene row.

decision: This is an execution failure, not a benchmark or model-quality result. Retain whole-episode recomputation and zero saved-activation host offload. During native forward and backward only, move the already-initialized fused-Adam state tensors to bounded CPU memory, return them byte-exactly to the owning GPU after the native graph is released, and stress the exact failure rows with initialized optimizer state before restarting from exact R12.
